description: .NET version upgrade plan from net8.0 to net10.0 for eShopOnWeb

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 8.0 is the current version, while .NET 10.0 is the latest Long-Term Support (LTS) release.
